cohort: 1,181,090 pregnant women and their singleton births in Finland between 1996 and 2016.
finding: Prenatal exposure to second-generation antipsychotics was associated with an increased risk of gestational diabetes, cesarean section, large for gestational age birth, preterm birth, and neonatal complications.
mod_finding: Cesarean section risk was higher in the S-GA group compared to the F-GA group.
